text:
elena-peopleops: We just pushed a small but important update to the Employee Handbook under 'Time Off & Leaves' clarifying bereavement leave eligibility, documentation requirements, and a short exception process for international team members. Please read and complete the acknowledgment + 5-min microtraining by Thu 2026-04-09: https://handbook.redwood.com/timeoff/bereavement-update

ben-engineering: Thanks for the heads up. Does this affect people who already filed time off for the same reason?

elena-peopleops: Good Q 1 — no retroactive changes. Existing approved leaves remain under the rules in effect at approval. New requests on/after 2026-04-01 follow the new guidance. We'll add a note to the FAQ.

mina-manager: For international folks, what's the "exception process" look like? I have two directs in EMEA who asked.

elena-peopleops: We added a short flow: (1) manager flags case to people-ops, (2) people-ops consults Legal/Comp, (3) an approved exception is documented in Workday with a note. We included contact and timeline details on the handbook page.

sam-compensation: Also noting we added a small stipend floor for travel-related bereavement expenses for people outside the US; Finance will handle reimbursements. Details: expense code BEREAV-TRAVEL.

hr-notice-bot: Reminder scheduled  Microtraining assignments will be sent tomorrow at 09:00 PT.

ben-engineering: Can managers see completion status for our directs? Trying to avoid chasing 1:1s.

elena-peopleops: Yes, managers get a roster export with completion statuses. We'll send that the day after reminders go out.

mina-manager: Thanks. Can you add a 2-sentence "what to tell your team" blurb? Managers want copy-paste language.

elena-peopleops: Done  added "Manager talking points" and a sample Slack blurb in the handbook page. Copy-paste friendly.

ben-engineering: One last Q: if a contractor needs an exception, can we apply the same process?

elena-peopleops: Contractors are considered case-by-case; exceptions can be made but payment/reimbursements depend on local contracting rules. Flag via people-ops and include contractor agreement info.

sam-compensation: Finance note: international reimbursements may need additional paperwork. Please CC finance@redwood when you submit exceptions.

elena-peopleops: Thanks all. I'll post a short announcement in #general and add the manager roster export to the drive. Ping me for edge cases. :heart:
